subject: Demo scheduling with ACME — re:Invent blackout week
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Demo request / schedule for Redwood trial

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the follow-up. We'd like to schedule a demo of Redwood Inference for our platform team — ideally the week of Nov 27 so we can align with our internal kickoff. Availability on our side is:

- Thu Nov 27: 10:00–12:00 PT (preferred)
- Fri Nov 28: 09:00–11:00 PT

If those don't work, we can also do early mornings (7:30–9:00 PT) on Nov 25–26.

High-level agenda: a 45-minute walkthrough of model serving + 15 minutes for Q&A and next steps.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Corp
jordan.lee@acme.com
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request / schedule for Redwood trial

Hi Jordan — thanks for the options and the agenda. Quick heads up: several members of our product and solutions team will be attending AWS re:Invent the week of Nov 26–30 and we have a partial blackout for demos during those days.

Can we do one of the alternatives below?

- Tue Nov 18: 10:00–11:00 PT (my preference)
- Wed Nov 19: 08:00–09:00 PT (early)
- Tue Dec 2: 09:00–10:00 PT (post-re:Invent)

If you need the week of Nov 27, I can check whether Jon or Marissa can cover an early slot, but our product lead won't be available for a deep technical walkthrough that week.

Also, would you like us to share a short runbook and the pricing sheet ahead of time? I can attach a one-pager.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Demo request / schedule for Redwood trial — ACME (internal)

Stephanie — forwarding Jordan's note.

Quick internal: our product lead (Anita) is confirmed at re:Invent Nov 27–29 and won't be available for a technical deep dive that week. Jonas, are you able to take an earlier slot (Nov 18/19) for an architecture-focused demo? If not, we should push to Tue Dec 2 when we have full coverage.

I'll attach the runbook and a lightweight pricing sheet for Jordan to review before the call.

Attachments: demo-runbook.pdf (application/pdf), pricing-sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0147

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request / schedule for Redwood trial

Thanks — Dec 2 at 09:00 PT works for our team. Please send a calendar invite for Dec 2, 9:00–10:00 PT and include the runbook and pricing sheet.

We may add our security lead (Marta Alvarez) to the invite for a short SOC 2 / compliance Q&A at the end; that should be fine, right?

Appreciate the flexibility.

Jordan
